label: Every being contingent at w is in POTENCY_1 in some respect
paraphrase: OPEN, sense-sensitive bridge (B4), analyst formulation, attribution deferred: every candidate contingent at w is in POTENCY_1 (the adopted capacity of the bearer itself, MUTABLE_1, potency in the subject) in some respect. It says that possible nonexistence is grounded in an intrinsic potency of the bearer. It is the converse direction of both existing bridges relating potency and possible non-being (every potency is of the contradictory; what can fail to be possibly is not), which therefore do not supply it (controls). Possible non-being through another's power over the bearer's esse (MUTABLE_2) does not satisfy it.
